violations.why: irq_umbra (prio 5) can preempt irq_bluff between its write and read of v_fern, so the read can see 1 instead of 0.
irq_umbra can preempt irq_bluff between the two reads, so they can return different values.
irq_ermine (prio 4) preempts the v_saffron++ read-modify-write in irq_prism (prio 2), and its write of 10 is lost.
irq_falcon (prio 3) can preempt irq_ember (prio 1) between its two writes of v_sable and read an intermediate state.
irq_ermine or irq_umbra preempts irq_falcon between its write of 42 and the read check, which can see a different value.
irq_ermine (prio 4) preempts irq_rust (prio 2) between its write and read of v_birch.
irq_ermine preempts irq_ember between its write and read of v_birch.
irq_ermine preempts irq_falcon between its write of 1 and its read of v_nectar, so the read can see 0.
irq_ermine preempts irq_rust between its write and read of v_nectar.
irq_ermine preempts irq_ember between its write and read of v_nectar.
irq_umbra sets v_nectar to 1 between irq_bluff's write of 0 and its check.
irq_umbra sets v_nectar to 1 between irq_prism's write of 0 and its check.
irq_umbra (prio 5) preempts irq_vine (prio 3) between its write and read of v_nectar.
irq_umbra (prio 5) preempts irq_ermine (prio 4) between its write and read of v_nectar.
